Access_Overview.en-US: Explore the login and account selection examples.
Access_Overview.zh-CN: 查看登录与账号选择示例。

Access_DemoOnly.en-US: Local demo only. Do not enter real credentials.
Access_DemoOnly.zh-CN: 仅为本地演示，请勿输入真实凭据。

Access_LoginDescription.en-US: Enter a fictitious email and password.
Access_LoginDescription.zh-CN: 请输入虚构邮箱与密码。

Access_AccountsDescription.en-US: Choose an example account or use another email.
Access_AccountsDescription.zh-CN: 选择示例账号，或使用其他邮箱。

Access_Remember.zh-CN: 在本次演示中记住邮箱

Access_InvalidEmail.en-US: Use a valid email format, such as visitor@example.invalid.
Access_InvalidEmail.zh-CN: 请输入有效邮箱格式，例如 visitor@example.invalid。

Access_RequiredPassword.en-US: Enter any fictitious password to exercise the required field.
Access_RequiredPassword.zh-CN: 请输入任意虚构密码以验证必填字段。

Access_Accepted.en-US: Success demo. No sign-in occurred; the password was cleared.
Access_Accepted.zh-CN: 成功演示，未实际登录；密码已清空。

Access_Rejected.en-US: Rejected demo. Enter a fictitious password to retry.
Access_Rejected.zh-CN: 拒绝演示，请重新输入虚构密码后重试。

Access_Empty.zh-CN: 没有已保存的示例账号

Access_EmptyDescription.en-US: Continue with another fictitious email or restore the original fixtures.
Access_EmptyDescription.zh-CN: 可使用另一个虚构邮箱，或恢复初始示例数据。

Access_DisabledAccount.en-US: Unavailable fixture. Selection is disabled; removal is still allowed.
Access_DisabledAccount.zh-CN: 不可用示例账号。选择已禁用，但仍可移除。

Access_SelectionRejected.en-US: This example account is unavailable or no longer exists. Choose another account.
Access_SelectionRejected.zh-CN: 此示例账号不可用或已不存在，请选择其他账号。

Access_AccountsChanged.en-US: The example list was changed locally. No real account was modified.
Access_AccountsChanged.zh-CN: 示例列表已在本地更新；没有修改任何真实账号。

Access_Selected.en-US: Email filled. Enter a fictitious password.
Access_Selected.zh-CN: 已填入邮箱，请输入虚构密码。

Display_Intro.en-US: Presentation pages use full-width backgrounds with centered controls. These fictitious examples contain no authentication, licensing or billing behavior.
Display_Intro.zh-CN: 展示页面使用全宽背景与居中控件。这些虚构案例不执行认证、许可或计费行为。

Display_ProductDescription.en-US: Lumen is a fictitious product used to demonstrate library-owned banners, artistic titles, standard actions and a wordmark footer.
Display_ProductDescription.zh-CN: Lumen 是虚构产品，用于演示库内横幅、艺术标题、标准动作和品牌大字页脚。

Display_ContainerExplanation.en-US: The surface fills the available page width. Headings, body text and controls remain in the shared centered container, including narrow screens.
Display_ContainerExplanation.zh-CN: 表面背景铺满可用页面宽度；标题、正文与控件保持在共享的居中限宽容器中，并适配窄屏。

Display_OfferDescription.en-US: Fictitious display data only; no purchase is available.
Display_OfferDescription.zh-CN: 仅为虚构展示数据，不提供购买。

Display_Submitted.en-US: Local demonstration completed. No credentials were sent or validated.
Display_Submitted.zh-CN: 本地演示完成，没有发送或验证任何凭据。

Display_Disclaimer.en-US: Lumen is fictitious · no commercial offer
Display_Disclaimer.zh-CN: Lumen 为虚构品牌 · 非商业报价

Home_FrameworkDescription.en-US: Configure the top bar, navigation, commands and application shell.
Home_FrameworkDescription.zh-CN: 配置顶部栏、导航、命令和页面外壳。

Home_ControlsDescription.en-US: Browse components, variants, APIs and interactive examples.
Home_ControlsDescription.zh-CN: 查看控件目录、变体、用法和交互演示。

Home_FoundationsDescription.en-US: Explore typography, colors, spacing, radius and themes.
Home_FoundationsDescription.zh-CN: 查看字体、颜色、间距、圆角和主题。

Home_ExamplesDescription.en-US: Compose forms, lists, enum selection and search.
Home_ExamplesDescription.zh-CN: 组合表单、列表、枚举选择和搜索。

Home_SetupDescription.en-US:
Use ApplicationLayout as the default route layout and create your pages.
Design is optional; Framework provides layout and behavior.
Home_SetupDescription.zh-CN:
将路由的默认布局设置为 ApplicationLayout，再创建自己的页面。
Design 是可选主题；Framework 提供布局和交互行为。

Localization_Scope.en-US:
Changes belong to this circuit.
Reloading restores the browser request language.
Localization_Scope.zh-CN:
切换只影响当前会话。
刷新会恢复浏览器请求选择的语言。

Localization_Introduction.en-US:
The application and framework use separate embedded catalogs.
A scoped bridge resolves shell labels without changing routes or commands.
Localization_Introduction.zh-CN:
应用与框架使用独立的嵌入词典。
Scoped 桥接解析外壳文案，不改变路由或命令。

Dialog_Body.en-US: The close button is provided by the framework text catalog.
Dialog_Body.zh-CN: 关闭按钮的文案来自框架词典。

Display_CustomSupport.en-US: Need more features? Contact us for support.
Display_CustomSupport.zh-CN: 需要更多功能？请联系我们以获得支持。
